caption: The drawing is black and white and consists of architectural details and a street scene. On the left and top sides are detailed line drawings of cast iron railing and bracket designs, featuring geometric and ornamental patterns including squares, circles,, and foliage elements, with the left border measuring 24 inches high and the lower section marked as 32 inches high. In the top right area, there is a separate, framed illustration showing the corner of a two-story house with a balcony, constructed with vertical and horizontal wooden slats; a person is walking on the street below, where a portion of a car is parked on the right side in the foreground. Ornate scrollwork decorates the top left corner of this framing box. Below the house illustration is a horizontal band showing the base of the cast iron railing. At the very bottom of the page, within a rectangular box, there is a title: "CAST IRON BALCONY RAILING & BRACKET." The composition is drawn entirely in pen, with fine lines to create shading and texture.
title: Iron Work on Balcony
